import hashlib,json,sys,zipfile,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('__LOCAL_HOME__/Projects/JavaProjects/docweave');ns={'m':'http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0'};parent=ET.parse(root/'pom.xml').getroot();license=(root/'LICENSE').read_bytes();rows=[]
for element in parent.findall('m:modules/m:module',ns):
 module=element.text;p=root/module;model=ET.parse(p/'pom.xml').getroot();artifact=model.findtext('m:artifactId',namespaces=ns);stem=p/'target'/f'{artifact}-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT'
 if model.findtext('m:properties/m:maven.deploy.skip',namespaces=ns)=='true':
  assert not Path(str(stem)+'-sources.jar').exists(),module
  assert not Path(str(stem)+'-javadoc.jar').exists(),module
  continue
 archives={}
 for classifier in ('','-sources','-javadoc'):
  jar=Path(str(stem)+classifier+'.jar')
  with zipfile.ZipFile(jar) as z:
   names=z.namelist();licensepath='resources/META-INF/LICENSE' if classifier=='-javadoc' and module!='docweave-all' else 'META-INF/LICENSE';assert z.read(licensepath)==license,(module,classifier,licensepath)
   prefix='resources/' if classifier=='-javadoc' and module!='docweave-all' else ''
   assert z.read(prefix+'META-INF/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md')==(root/'THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md').read_bytes(),(module,classifier)
   for notice in (p/'src/main/resources/META-INF').glob('*'):
    if notice.is_file() and ('LICENSE' in notice.name or 'NOTICE' in notice.name):
     assert z.read(prefix+'META-INF/'+notice.name)==notice.read_bytes(),(module,classifier,notice.name)
   if classifier=='-sources':
    for source in (p/'src/main/java').rglob('*.java'):assert z.read(source.relative_to(p/'src/main/java').as_posix())==source.read_bytes(),source
   if classifier=='-javadoc':
    assert 'META-INF/README.md' in names if module=='docweave-all' else 'index.html' in names,module
   if module=='docweave-layout-onnx':
    notice='META-INF/Microsoft-TATR-LICENSE.txt';entry='resources/'+notice if classifier=='-javadoc' else notice;assert z.read(entry)==(p/'src/main/resources'/notice).read_bytes(),classifier
   assert not any(n.endswith(('.onnx','.traineddata','.pdf','.docx')) for n in names),(module,classifier)
   archives[classifier or 'binary']=dict(sha256=hashlib.sha256(jar.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),bytes=jar.stat().st_size,entries=len(names),license_entry=licensepath)
 rows.append(dict(module=module,artifact=artifact,archives=archives))
assert len(rows)==16,len(rows)
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(dict(runtime=sys.argv[2],publishable_jar_modules=len(rows),internal_harness_attachments_absent=True,artifacts=rows),indent=2)+'\n')
print('Verified binary/source/documentation archives for all16 publishable JAR modules; internal attachments absent.')
